\\c.title: Change Text Color
\\c.desc: Changes the text color using the standard color palette ID.

\\i.title: Display Icon
\\i.desc: Displays an icon in-line with the text from the system icon set.

\\v.title: Game Variable
\\v.desc: Gets replaced dynamically with the current value of the game variable ID.

\\n.title: Actor Name / Name Box
\\n.desc: Replaces with the name of the target Actor ID, or creates a left-aligned name box when used with angle brackets.

\\p.title: Party Member Name
\\p.desc: Gets replaced with the name of the active party member at the specified position index.

\\nc.title: Class Name / Centered Name Box
\\nc.desc: Replaces with a specific Class Name ID, or creates a centered name box when used with angle brackets.

\\nr.title: Right Name Box
\\nr.desc: Creates a right-aligned text name box container above the message panel.

\\px.title: Set Text X Position
\\px.desc: Explicitly offsets the current text drawing position along the X-axis.

\\py.title: Set Text Y Position
\\py.desc: Explicitly offsets the current text drawing position along the Y-axis.

\\oc.title: Set Outline Color
\\oc.desc: Changes the text outline/stroke color using a color palette ID.

\\ow.title: Set Outline Thickness
\\ow.desc: Sets the stroke line width weight. Requires an outline color to be defined beforehand.

\\fs.title: Set Font Size
\\fs.desc: Changes the font size dynamically to the specified numeric pixel value.

\\fn.title: Set Font Name
\\fn.desc: Sets the font family string. Default fallback is typically OMORI_GAME2.

\\m.title: Evaluate Message Macro
\\m.desc: Evaluates and expands a text macro string corresponding to the target ID.

\\sinv.title: Vertical Text Shake
\\sinv.desc: Makes the text shake vertically. Accepted values are 1 and 2 (2 produces a more dense wave).

\\sinh.title: Horizontal Text Shake
\\sinh.desc: Makes the text shake horizontally. Accepted value is 1.

\\quake.title: Aggressive Text Wobble
\\quake.desc: Makes the text wobble aggressively. Accepted values are 1 and 2 (2 is less intense).

\\rainbow.title: Animated Rainbow Effect
\\rainbow.desc: Adds a dynamic, animated cycling rainbow color effect to the text characters. Accepted value is 1.

\\com.title: Invoke Common Event
\\com.desc: Triggers a global Common Event script processing thread using the specified ID.

\\var.title: Set Variable Value
\\var.desc: Sets the targeted variable ID directly to the defined numeric value.

\\vara.title: Add to Variable
\\vara.desc: Adds the specified value directly to the existing total of the targeted variable ID.

\\vars.title: Subtract from Variable
\\vars.desc: Subtracts the specified value from the current balance of the targeted variable ID.

\\varx.title: Multiply Variable
\\varx.desc: Multiplies the current value of the targeted variable ID by the specified value.

\\vard.title: Divide Variable
\\vard.desc: Divides the current value of the targeted variable ID by the specified value.

\\varm.title: Modulo Variable
\\varm.desc: Sets the targeted variable ID to the remainder (modulo) of the variable divided by the value.

\\{.title: Increase Font Size
\\{.desc: Steps up the active text font scale size larger.

\\}.title: Decrease Font Size
\\}.desc: Steps down the active text font scale size smaller.

\\$.title: Show Currency Balance
\\$.desc: Opens and renders the current player money window layer in the top corner of the screen.

\\..title: Tiny Wait (15 Ticks)
\\..desc: Pauses text rendering progression for exactly 15 engine ticks.

\\|.title: Long Wait (60 Ticks)
\\|.desc: Pauses text rendering progression for exactly 60 engine ticks.

\\!.title: Wait for Input
\\!.desc: Pauses text animation stream until manual player button interaction is pressed.

\\>.title: Fast Text Animation
\\>.desc: Forces subsequent characters to print immediately without character drawing delays.

\\<.title: Reset Fast Animation
\\<.desc: Negates character skipping and resumes normal typing animation layouts.

\\^.title: Auto-Close Window
\\^.desc: Closes the current active text dialog screen immediately when text finishes drawing.

\\g.title: Print Currency Name
\\g.desc: Prints the text unit string of the currently used active game currency.

\\fr.title: Reset Font Changes
\\fr.desc: Resets all active bold, italic, sizing, and color overrides back to defaults.

\\fb.title: Toggle Font Bold
\\fb.desc: Toggles the bold font weight styling property switch on or off.

\\fi.title: Toggle Font Italic
\\fi.desc: Toggles the italic font styling property oblique switch on or off.

\\dii.title: Displays Input Icon
\\dii.desc: Displays the input icon for the given input id. The input id can be a string. Example usage: \DII[down]

<br>.title: Line Break
<br>.desc: Forces the text stream to wrap down to a new visual lines layout block.
